episodes.title: The Sphere
episodes.summary: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

episodes.title: The Inhabited
episodes.summary: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

episodes.title: Cleaner HQ
episodes.summary: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

episodes.title: Raiders
episodes.summary: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.

episodes.title: One Good Strike!!
episodes.summary: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.

episodes.title: A Score to Settle
episodes.summary: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.

episodes.title: Moving Forward
episodes.summary: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.

episodes.title: The City of Graffiti
episodes.summary: To get a "spell" for their next mission, the Cleaners head to Canvas Town, where they make a tragic discovery.

episodes.title: Penta: The Desert No Man's Land
episodes.summary: With their gear-up complete, the crew heads into the No Man's Land, Penta, to get clues about the Sphere.

episodes.title: Amo's Hospitality
episodes.summary: A mysterious woman living in the No Man's Land challenges the crew from an unexpected angle.

episodes.title: Something Like a Curse
episodes.summary: Tamsy and Zanka fight to save their captive allies. In the aftermath, Rudo has an unexpected reaction.

episodes.title: An Empty Gaze
episodes.summary: Amo tells the story of how she came to the tower and of the "angels" who came to visit her.

episodes.title: The Storm Before the Storm
episodes.summary: After returning from the Penta No Man's Land, Rudo and the Cleaners face a series of new threats.

episodes.title: Clash!
episodes.summary: Taken by the Raiders to an unknown setting, the Cleaners fight for their lives, and Zodyl makes Rudo an offer.

episodes.title: Gifted and Not
episodes.summary: Bundus interrogates the Santas while Zanka struggles to keep pace with a powered-up Jabber.

episodes.title: Memories of a Mediocrity
episodes.summary: Zanka reflects on the turning point in his past that brought him to where he is today.

episodes.title: Oh Zap, Totes Legit
episodes.summary: While the Raiders-Cleaners conflicts continue, the battle between Riyo and Noerde heats up.

episodes.title: Watchmen Series
episodes.summary: Zodyl reveals his plan to reach the Sphere, and the other Cleaners react to their current circumstances.

episodes.title: Ensign
episodes.summary: As the battle climaxes, Enjin makes a play to unite his team, and Zodyl makes his final entreaty to Rudo.

episodes.title: The Power of Protection
episodes.summary: An unexpected member of the Raiders returns in a last-ditch effort to keep the Cleaners locked down.

episodes.title: The Man Who Will Be Stronger
episodes.summary: As the Cleaners take stock after the battle, a convalescing Zanka receives some surprising news.

episodes.title: Field Trip
episodes.summary: Rudo and the other child Cleaners take a trip to Canvas Town while Corvus entertains some unwanted guests.
